item.title: Jury finds Nathan Chasing Horse guilty on 13 counts including sexual assault of a minor
item.description: Jurors convicted Nathan Chasing Horse on 10 counts of sexual assault on a minor, returning guilty verdicts on 13 of 21 counts in the actor's trial on Friday.

item.title: Here's how the average credit score in Nevada compares to other states
item.description: In order to determine which states had the highest and lowest credit scores, WalletHub compared the average credit scores of residents in all 50 states using TransUnion data in October 2025.

item.title: Joey Chestnut defends bagel-eating championship title in Las Vegas
item.description: The number-one-ranked competitive eater in the world defended his bagel-eating title at the fourth annual World Bagel Eating Championship in Las Vegas on Saturday.

item.title: Hair appointments, happy hour missed due to construction
item.description: The City of Las Vegas, along with the Regional Flood Control District have reduced Charleston to one lane due to the installation of a 8-foot by 7-foot storm drain box, due to be complete 2027. (James Schaeffer/KLAS)

item.title: 'Shut it Down' protestors gather in Las Vegas
item.description: Demonstrations took place across the country Friday, following widespread outrage over the recent death of intensive care nurse Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.

item.title: Why everyone in Las Vegas has a side hustle
item.description: In Las Vegas, having one job often isn’t the full picture.

item.title: Las Vegas teen charged after alleged brutal group sexual assault on private school field trip caught on video
item.description: Four eighth graders at a Las Vegas private school are accused of sexually assaulting another student during a field trip to Costa Rica, with one of the students, Vaughn Griffith, charged in adult court for possession of a visual presentation depicting the sexual assault.

item.title: Fatal crash near Las Vegas leaves motorcyclist dead
item.description: The Nevada Highway Patrol is investigating a fatal crash Saturday afternoon on southbound State Route 160 near mile marker 15 in Clark County.

item.title: Police, FBI find possible 'biological lab' at Las Vegas home
item.description: Las Vegas police and the FBI searched a home on the east side of Las Vegas Saturday morning, finding a "possible biological laboratory," including “refrigerators with vials containing unknown liquids.”

item.title: Neighbors say home with alleged bio lab was under surveillance
item.description: Neighbors said they are still in shock over the bizarre discovery of an alleged biological lab at a home along Sugar Springs Drive near East Washington Avenue and North Hollywood Boulevard.
